definitions: To spoil a happy occasion or a person's plans or enthusiasm.
To ruin someone's moment of success or joy.
examples: I hate to rain on your parade, but your flight has been cancelled.
She was so excited about her promotion, I didn't want to rain on her parade by mentioning the extra workload.
He always manages to rain on everyone's parade with his negativity.
synonyms: to throw a wet blanket on
